correctness.summary: Each E_p has mass 4/(p+1). For distinct primes, common Fourier frequencies occur only at multiples of pq; the one-zero coordinate classes contribute at most (8/3)psi(p)psi(q)/(pq) in total and the both-nonzero class at most 1/(9p^2q^2). These errors are summable on every tail. Since sum_p 4/(p+1) diverges, Chung-Erdos gives tail-union measure tending to 1, and intersecting all tail unions gives full limsup measure.

limitations: The theorem is stated for max-norm rectangles on T^2.
The originality assessment does not infer novelty solely from search non-detection.

originality.summary: Open literature covers full-denominator inhomogeneous Khintchine-Groshev theory, restricted lacunary/smooth denominator sets, and prime-constrained approximation, but the audit did not locate the exact two-dimensional fixed-shift prime-denominator theorem. Non-detection is treated only as qualified target-specific originality.

scientific_value.summary: The result supplies a clean full-measure theorem at the natural two-dimensional Dirichlet scale using prime reciprocal divergence and an explicit summable overlap estimate; the shift-uniform proof is stronger than the named example.
